description: This file defines the WordWidget class for an Android application, which displays the 'Word of the Day' from Wiktionary on a home screen widget. It includes an inner Service class that performs background API queries to fetch and display daily word information, handling updates and user interactions.

classes.name: WordWidget
classes.description: An AppWidgetProvider that initiates updates for the 'Word of the Day' widget.

classes.name: WordWidget.UpdateService
classes.description: A background service that fetches the latest 'Word of the Day' from Wiktionary API and updates the widget display.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Triggers a background service to update the widget when called.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes widget update, builds the RemoteViews, and updates the widget.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used in this service.

methods.name: buildUpdate
methods.description: Fetches the page content for the current day, extracts word details using regex, and constructs the RemoteViews for the widget display.
